payload.name: Range search for period-based activity questions
payload.description: When a question asks which/what activities, classes, or events a subject joined, started, or did during a named date range (e.g., 'mid-August 2023'), use time_mode 'range' with query variants for beginning activities, and retry before concluding no information is available.
content: When the question asks about activities that occurred or began during a named period (e.g., 'mid-August 2023', 'last week'), run at least one search with time_mode 'range' (or a widened time window) covering the entire period, not only a point-in-time search.

Include in that search query variants that express beginning an activity (e.g., 'started', 'joined', 'enrolled', 'began'), because memories may state the event relative to the session date (e.g., 'started taking classes a few days ago').
Stop once you have retrieved memories that cover the named period and the asked activity type; do not keep adding unrelated searches or memories after the question is answerable.

solves: This solves the failure where a single point-in-time search misses memories whose events are described relative to the session timestamp (e.g., 'a few days ago') even though their inferred date falls in the named period, leading to a premature 'No information available'. It applies to future questions asking what/which activities, classes, or events a subject joined or began during a date range. It must not trigger for questions about a single anchored timestamp or when the first search already returns directly relevant evidence.
